items.lede: Meta is making the platform even better for podcast promotion.
items.title: Threads leans even further into podcasts with transcripts, analytics and more

items.lede: Threads is rolling out new tools for podcasters, including profile cards, episode links, transcripts, guest tags, posting reminders, and audience insights, as Meta looks to make the X rival a bigger hub for podcast promotion and discussion.
items.title: Threads’ new features let podcasters promote shows and reach listeners
